title: jscpd gate is a permanent false positive: `"format": "console"` makes jscpd analyze zero files
body:
## Summary

`.jscpd.json` in this template sets `"format": "console"`. In jscpd, `format` is the list of **languages/formats to analyze**, not the output format — output is controlled by `reporters` (which this file already sets correctly).

Because `console` is not a source language, jscpd matches **zero files** and always reports `Found 0 clones.` The duplication gate is therefore a permanent false positive: it can never fail, no matter how much duplicated code a repository contains.

Found while working on [link-foundation/start#158](https://github.com/link-foundation/start/issues/158) ("check for all false positives, false negatives, warnings and errors in CI/CD").

## Reproducible example

Two deliberately identical files plus this template's `format` setting:

```bash
mkdir jscpd-repro && cd jscpd-repro
printf 'function a(){\n  const x=1;\n  const y=2;\n  const z=3;\n  return x+y+z;\n}\n' > a.js
printf 'function b(){\n  const x=1;\n  const y=2;\n  const z=3;\n  return x+y+z;\n}\n' > b.js
printf '{"threshold":0,"minTokens":10,"minLines":3,"format":"console","reporters":["console"]}' > .jscpd.json

npx --yes jscpd .
```

Actual output:

```
Found 0 clones.
```

Exit code `0` — the gate passes despite 100 % duplication between the two files.

Remove `"format": "console"` (or set it to real languages) and re-run:

```bash
npx --yes jscpd . --format javascript
```

```
Found 1 clones.
ERROR: jscpd found too many duplicates (41.7%) over threshold (0.0%)
```

This is not theoretical for real repositories either: in a repository using this template's config verbatim, `npx jscpd .` reports "No duplicates found", while `npx jscpd . --format "javascript"` on the same tree reports 24 files / 49 clones / **5.64 %** duplication.

## Workaround

Override on the command line until the config is fixed:

```bash
npx jscpd . --format "javascript,typescript,jsx,tsx,markdown"
```

## Suggested fix

Drop the `format` key so jscpd uses its default language set, or list the languages the repository actually contains. `reporters` already carries the console output, so nothing is lost:

```diff
   "ignore": [
     ...
   ],
-  "format": "console",
   "reporters": ["console", "html"],
   "output": "./reports/jscpd"
 }
```

or, to be explicit:

```diff
-  "format": "console",
+  "format": ["javascript", "jsx", "typescript", "tsx", "json", "markdown", "yaml"],
```

Note that fixing this will make the gate start reporting real duplication, so repositories adopting the fix may need to set a non-zero `threshold` (or extend `ignore`) in the same change rather than being surprised by a suddenly red pipeline.

## Suggested regression test

Since the failure mode is silent, a check that jscpd actually analyzed something is worth adding to the workflow — e.g. assert the JSON reporter's `statistics.total.sources > 0`, so a future config typo fails loudly instead of turning the gate green.
